caption: The drawing is rendered on a beige, lightly textured background and features multiple outlined pattern pieces, each labeled with letters and numbers. At the top left, there is a long, horizontal rectangular shape labeled "H," and beneath it a smaller, rounded rectangle labeled "K." Groups of smaller, straight pieces labeled "F" and "G" are placed in the upper center. To the upper right are two large, roughly triangular shapes labeled "A1" and "A2," with curved notches and labeled "CENTER BACK" and "CENTER FRONT." Below these are two sets of irregularly shaped pieces; the left group is labeled "E," "D," and "CENTER BACK," consisting of several segment-like shapes aligned with numbers and lines. The right group, labeled "B" and "CENTER FRONT," has a similar segmented structure with notches and marks along the edges. At the bottom of the image, there are two large, fan-shaped objects: the left one is labeled "I" and "STRAIGHT GRAIN," covered with numerous small notations and segmented lines, while the right piece is labeled "J" and has a curved, shell-like outline. A scale for measurement is marked at the bottom right corner. All lines and text are hand-drawn in black or dark gray ink.
title: Pattern for Dress
